sheets.title: Settings › Vaults, top of the page — 1280 × 800
sheets.caption: A sealed password vault, then Settings › Vaults. The base draws the creation form on the page: a label, a field and a key under the list of vaults. On the branch the list has one key in its head, and the form waits in a sheet.
sheets.before: name field and create key drawn on the page
sheets.after: list and one + key in the panel head; no form on the page

sheets.title: Sealing a new vault — 1280 × 800
sheets.caption: The base has no ceremony here, so its picture is the page with the inline form. On the branch the + key opens a ceremony sheet: a name, the choice of this vault's key or its own, and the facts each choice implies. The commit key is inside the card.
sheets.after: sheet with name, key choice, two facts and Seal vault

sheets.title: Settings › Vaults › Travel — 1280 × 800
sheets.caption: Work is sealed with the same key and the personal vault is open. The base draws the whole travel plan on the page: a list of vaults with switches and a commit. The branch draws two rows, one action each: turn travel mode on, turn it off.
sheets.before: inline safe-for-travel switches on the page
sheets.after: two rows and two keys; no switches on the page

sheets.title: Turning travel mode on — 1280 × 800
sheets.caption: On the branch the first row's key opens the ceremony in a sheet: what travels, what leaves, the safe list, then Pack the rest for travel. The base has no such key, so its picture is the same page.
sheets.after: ceremony sheet: facts + safe list + one commit

sheets.title: Turning travel mode off — 1280 × 800
sheets.caption: The second row's key opens the way home: a bundle, its return code, then a preview of what would come home before anything is written.
sheets.before: no key; return hidden until a key in the panel head
sheets.after: ceremony sheet: bundle, return code, one commit

sheets.title: Item types and what follows — 1280 × 800
sheets.caption: The base lists Item types, then a Sample data panel with a + key. The branch has no Sample data panel: it was never asked for.

sheets.title: Settings › Vaults › Sealed store — 1280 × 800
sheets.caption: The base dumps the ceremony's card — entries, what it holds, the command — on the page under the title. The branch keeps a row with the count and its one key; the card is in the sheet the key opens.
sheets.before: ceremony card drawn on the page
sheets.after: one row: name, entry count, one key

sheets.title: Travel as a guest — 1280 × 800
sheets.caption: A guest carries nothing to travel with. The base shows a lock and nothing else, so the panel reads as broken. The branch shows both rows with their keys disabled and the reason on each.
sheets.after: two rows, both keys disabled, reason on each

sheets.title: Settings › Vaults › Travel — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: The same two rows on a phone. Keys are the phone's 44px size.
sheets.after: two rows, keys at the touch floor

sheets.title: The ceremony on a phone — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: The sheet is a bottom sheet on a phone; the card, its list and its commit fit the width without horizontal scroll.
